name: Sparsity-promoting Fine-tuning
definition: A fine-tuning stage applied before transform coding to improve energy compaction in the transform domain and rate-distortion performance by optimizing appearance attributes while keeping Gaussian positions fixed.
summary: Sparsity-promoting fine-tuning optimizes 3D Gaussian Splatting appearance attributes to enhance compression by penalizing large transform coefficients, distinguishing itself from standard quantization-aware fine-tuning.
